reasoning: In March 2023, researchers Daniel Martin Katz, Michael J. Bommarito II, Shang Gao, and Pablo Arredondo published a study demonstrating that OpenAI's GPT-4 successfully passed the Uniform Bar Exam (UBE). GPT-4 scored a 298, which comfortably exceeds the passing threshold of any U.S. jurisdiction (the highest of which is 270) and placed it in the 90th percentile of test-takers overall. Although subsequent academic critiques (such as a study by Eric Martinez) suggested that the "90th percentile" figure might be slightly overstated due to comparing GPT-4's mock exam performance to actual July exam administrations (proposing instead a range around the 68th percentile when compared to all test-takers), both assessments confirm that the AI model passed the exam with a score well above the average. Newer models like Claude 3 and GPT-4o have further solidified these capabilities.
title: AI systems now pass the bar exam
